title: Volume Control OCD Check
description: How do you handle the volume number on your remote?

questions.text: The TV volume is at 19. What do you do?

choices.label: Instant panic. Must go to 18 or 20.
It hurts, but I'll make it 20.
Only if 19 is not my lucky number.
Is the sound okay? Then keep it.

questions.text: The volume bar is odd. How does it make you feel?

choices.label: Physically uncomfortable, angry.
Slightly annoyed, I will fix it.
Neutral, unless it's a 'bad' number.
I don't even look at the number.

questions.text: The volume is 22, but slightly too loud. Where do you put it?

choices.label: Must be 20. Only even numbers.
Must be 20. Base 10 is perfect.
17. It's my specific favorite.
21. It sounds just right.

questions.text: You catch the car radio volume at 13. What is your reaction?

choices.label: Unacceptable. Immediate change to 12 or 14.
Change to 15 or 10 quickly.
Keep it, 13 is good for me.
No reaction, I'm just driving.

questions.text: What is the most 'satisfying' volume number?

choices.label: Any number that is perfectly even (e.g., 22, 24).
Numbers ending in 0 or 5 (e.g., 15, 20).
A specific eccentric number I love (e.g., 17).
I don't care about satisfying numbers.
